text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience in Python and machine learning, and I’d be glad to help build your German affiliate website for latexandlovers.de.

For this kind of project, I can support the content and structure of a simple, user-friendly site that matches the feel of your existing latexandlovers.co.uk presence, while keeping the affiliate links to eBay and Amazon clear and seamlessly integrated. I’m also comfortable working with German content using AI translation tools when needed, and I can apply basic SEO best practices so the site is set up with search visibility in mind.

To give you a sense of my background, I’ve built practical, data-focused tools that turn large amounts of content into something organized and usable. At Cobalt Coffee Roasters, I created a small Streamlit app that grouped 38k marketplace reviews into themes and tracked sentiment weekly, which resulted in 12 stable themes and replaced about 2 days a month of manual tagging. At Marrow & Pine Grocers, I built weekly store-by-SKU forecasts for 420 SKUs across 31 stores, scheduled in Airflow and written back to BigQuery, which reduced WAPE from 31% to 19% and cut spoilage write-offs by 11% in pilot stores.

While those projects were not web design projects, they reflect the same strengths I’d bring here: organized implementation, attention to detail, and a practical approach to building something reliable and useful. I’m comfortable working with content workflows, structuring information cleanly, and making sure the final result is clear for users.

If needed, I can keep the scope lean and focused so the site stays simple, effective, and aligned with your budget. I’d be happy to help you get this launched smoothly.

Would you like the site to be a single-page landing page or a small multi-page website?
